_comment: Issue #24: bounty_crab_cull end to end -- accept at Selys's desk (guild), win the rock_crab_nest fight (floodplains) TWICE with a real sleep between them (respawns:true only re-arms at the next sleep, and the condition is delta-since-accept >= 2), turn in for the exact 5 gold payout. Cross-map hops the fixture/subject don't need to re-prove (guild<->street<->floodplains, the sleep-bed walk) are `teleport`s, same FIXTURE-FIRST rationale board_loop's own sleep leg documents -- the real, walked halves are the desk approach (fixture-positioned) and the crab's own interact-adjacency (proving rock_crab_nest's placement/trigger contract for real, both times).

steps._comment: == ROTATION, PRE-STATE == times_slept 17 -> pool window [17,18,19] = second_watch/pond_keepsakes/crab_cull (data/bounties.json's append order -- crab_cull is the newest, last entry).
== ACCEPT == already at the desk-approach cell (fixture-positioned, board_loop's own verified (8,3)) -- fresh waking, first interact plays Selys's rotating pool line, second opens the real graph.
steps.name: interact

steps._comment: Fresh state: idx0 'Just looking around.', idx1 'How does the board work?', idx2 'Take on a posting.' (board_accepted false) -- 'Turn in my posting.' hidden.

Picker options render posting TITLES (WIBounties._posting_title): ['Take: Settle Two More Quarrels.' (second_watch, 0), 'Take: Report the Pond Cache.' (pond_keepsakes, 1), 'Take: Rock Crab Cull, East Hills.' (crab_cull, 2), 'Never mind.' (3)] -- pick index 2.

payload_contains.speaker: Selys
payload_contains.text: That one? Fine. Logged. Don't die over a handful of gold. It's paperwork for me and embarrassing for you.

steps._comment: == TRAVEL (1st) == teleport to floodplains, 2 cells south of rock_crab_nest (21,16) -- the guild<->street<->floodplains route is proven elsewhere (combat_walkthrough/economy_loop/gate_district_walkthrough), the subject here is the bounty+fight loop. Move up 2 for a REAL approach: the first step is open ground, the second is blocked by the entity at (21,16), stopping at (21,17) facing up -- proves rock_crab_nest's own interact-adjacency for real.
== FIGHT (1st) == interact-only trigger (no trigger_radius) -- a chosen fight, not a proximity ambush. met_relc banked in the fixture, so ally_requires fields Relc on the player side.
steps.name: interact

steps._comment: rock_crabs_culled banks synchronously inside resolve_combat, BEFORE ui_combat_hidden's own presentation-close event (combat_finished -> accomplishment_recorded -> combat_resolved -> ui_combat_hidden, traced from a real run) -- asserted as STATE here, same idiom combat_walkthrough's own post-fight accomplishment check uses, rather than wait_for_event (which would search PAST the since-marker cursor ui_combat_hidden's own wait just advanced, and time out for real -- the event already happened, it just isn't AHEAD of the cursor anymore).
delta-since-accept is 1 of the 2 needed -- posting stays accepted, unmet (opaque-safe: no progress readout anywhere).

== SLEEP == respawns:true only re-arms a dormant encounter at the NEXT sleep (sleep() clears dormant_encounters wholesale) -- teleport to bed upstairs (debug bypass, the inn walk is proven elsewhere), one cell short of the approach cell so a REAL move picks up the correct facing (transition() never touches player_facing).
== TRAVEL (2nd) + FIGHT (2nd) == same teleport-then-real-approach idiom as the first leg; rock_crab_nest is dormant no longer.
delta-since-accept is now 2 of 2 -- condition_met would read true, but nothing auto-completes: turn-in is Selys's own explicit action.

== TURN IN == teleport back to the desk-approach cell, one cell south so a real move picks up the correct UP facing. New waking since the sleep (social_talked cleared) -- first interact plays the pool line again.
board_accepted true: idx0 'Just looking around.', idx1 'How does the board work?', idx2 'Turn in my posting.'

Emission order (board_loop's own traced precedent): turn_in_bounty() resolves + pays out BEFORE _open_board_turnin_dialogue starts the display graph -- gold_changed/toast/completed_bounty fire first, THEN dialogue_started{board_turnin}, THEN dialogue_node. gold delta/total are both 5 (the fixture starts at 0 gold, no other gold source in this run -- rock_crab_nest carries no loot table, deliberately, per its own comment).

payload_contains.speaker: Selys
payload_contains.text: Done? …So it is. Here. Counted twice, because the last adventurer counted once, loudly, and was wrong. The Guild thanks you. I'm the Guild. So: thanks.
